title: A mechanism to determine Compensation on account of installation of Emission Control System by the generating companies in compliance with the Revised Emission Standards issued by Ministry of Environment, Forest & Climate Change (MoEF&CC), Government of India, vide Environment (Protection) Amendment Rules, 2015 on 07.12.2015 in respect of the Thermal Generating stations whose tariff is determined through competitive bidding under Section 63 of the Electricity Act, 2003.
